usage: xo version [--json | -v]
       xo version -m [--json] BINARY...

Print the toolchain version and the host target. --json and -v add
what the binary was built from: the commit, whether the tree had
uncommitted changes (and a hash of them), the source key, and the xo
that built it (decision 0264). -m prints the build information a
program built by xo carries, on every backend (decision 0354): the xo,
backend and target, its ID and directory, every effective setting
(debug contracts, dbg, error args, debug info, profiler and trace
support, the LLVM level), the stamps, and its sources' hashes; --json
prints it as recorded.
